UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE
Farm Service Agency                                                                 Notice DMC-53
Washington, DC 20250

For: State and County Offices

        Announcing Dairy Margin Coverage (DMC) Program Feed Cost Adjustment
          Using Premium Alfalfa for 2020 and 2021 Retroactive Payment Triggers
Approved: Acting Deputy Administrator, Farm Programs




1      Retroactive DMC Margin Payment Trigger

       A Background

           DMC payments are triggered when the difference between the National all milk price and the
           National average feed cost (the margin) falls below the producer selected margin trigger,
           ranging from Tier 1 from $4.00 to $9.50, and Tier 2 from $4.00 to $8.00, calculated monthly.

           USDA previously used prices for milk and feed components (corn, blended alfalfa hay, and
           soybean meal) to determine the National average margin for each month.

           The DMC regulation at 7 CFR Part 1430 was amended and published in the Federal Register
           on December 1, 2021, to use premium alfalfa hay rather than blended alfalfa hay in the feed
           cost calculation used to determine the National average margin for each month.
           Additionally, the regulation authorizes the feed cost calculation change to be effective
           starting in January 2020. Consequently, the margin will be recalculated for January 2020
           through October 2021 using premium alfalfa as part of the feed component to determine
           DMC payments.

           Retroactive payments for margins triggered will be issued directly to producers. DMC
           payments issued will not be offset by premium balances due, unless assigned by the dairy
           operation.

       B Purpose

           This notice informs State and County Offices that January 2020 through October 2021
           retroactive payments for dairy operations that elected the applicable margin trigger will
           automatically be processed beginning on December 13, 2021.
